comment: Mbemba is one of the most genuine teachers I have had in my life. He is a fantastic teacher that will be willing to do whatever it takes to help you understand and gain a general interest in the material you are learning. He loves his students, bringing the same enthusiasm and desire to teach to every class. Take Mbemba, he is an amazing man.

Mbemba is the man. Always happy, always willing to help, and just wants you to do your best. Always asks how your day has been and how you're doing in other classes when you walk in the room. Tests come from examples in the book. Love this guy

Dr. Mbemba is a great professor. He is very kind and really cares about his students. He is a very knowledgeable person with a great deal of integrity. He has a vested interest in the success of his students and is very enthusiastic about his classes. An admirable scholar and wonderful teacher.
Professor Mbemba is wonderful, he is so helpful out of class. If you have a question he will do everything he can to help. His class will challenge and prepare you.

Dr. Mbemba is an Excellent Professor that knows exactly the materials and is comfortable while teaching it! He is a Great and Awesome Instructor who does not hesitate giving important advices! Business Statistics may be Challenging but he manages to make this class very interesting! Also Easy easy A!
He is the greatest Professor. makes the class very easy,I hear B-Stats is the hardest class however taking it with Prof Mbemba makes it fun and easy.he is helpful and understanding.

A genuine man. His goal is to teach statistics in the least stressful and most efficient manor. You can go see him about absolutely anything and he loves to just sit down and have a pleasant conversation. If you want to learn statistics without ever getting stressed out with a very personable professor, take him take him take him.

Awesome prof. genuinely cares for his students. will even help you with gathering contacts within the real world. He always refers back to real life examples when explaining concepts, which really helps. He does have an accent, but it doesn't affect his teaching at all. Dont understand why anyone would complain about it. Its really not that bad.

Prof Mbemba is great. He's the nicest guy and he does care about you success in more than just his class. He talks a lot about the importance of morals, family, and effort. His accent is tough to get used to (hence the clarity score) but he really is a great person and I would definitely take another one of his classes.

Best professor I've had so far. His students are his number1 priority and he's willing to help us out in any way possible. You can walk into his office any time during the day and he'll be willing to spare hours for you. The class might seem easy, but thats because he goes through the content in extreme detail. Do take him if you have the chance.

*Haven't finished the class yet* Good: He's really easy, give you everything you need to know to pass, tells you how to do homework. Bad: His accent is thick and hard to understand. He doesn't really know how to do the problems (ask him if you're doing it right when doing it two different ways and he will say yes). Super boring class bring a pillow
